packageRules.description: Pin Docker image digests so a stale :latest can't drift into a GitHub-deprecated runner binary. TODO: promote pinDigests for Docker into jellyrock/.github//renovate/default once validated here; current org default only pins github-actions digests.

myoung34/github-runner bundles the GitHub Actions runner binary, which GitHub deprecates every 1-3 months. Auto-merge digest bumps once CI passes — keeping current is what prevents the deprecation restart-loop.
